name: Spring Boot
description: Spring Boot projects: application.properties and application.yml highlighted and folded, their properties completed, documented and checked from the configuration metadata in the project's own jars, run configurations of kind Spring Boot for @SpringBootApplication classes with active profiles and property overrides, gutter navigation between beans and their injection points, the Endpoints tool window, Spring Boot versions past their open-source support marked in build files, new projects from Spring Initializr, and Edit Starters for an open project.

help.en: The Spring Initializr service that lists the choices and builds the projects: your company's own instance, or the public one when empty.
help.ru: Сервис Spring Initializr, который даёт варианты и собирает проекты: собственный сервис компании, если поле пусто — публичный.
